title: feat(nm2orionez): lex-one signed-outgoing det orientation of 1-in 2-out at t+1 on two-axis opposite z-probes: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Lex-one signed Orient on the opposite z-probe cell: -1,+1,-1,-1 -> reverse fail, face HOLD. Completes the triad: on ONE identical cell the opposite-pair convention gives (HOLD,fail), unique-signed gives (fail,fail), lex-one gives (fail,HOLD), and the unsigned lex variant gives -1,+1,+1,+1. Four conventions, three distinct verdict pairs, one dataset.
